text: The public library opened a new reading room on Monday. The reading room seats forty visitors. Staff added evening hours so visitors can use the reading room after work. The library will review attendance after three months.
reference: The library opened a forty-seat reading room and added evening hours.

text: The weather was clear on Saturday. Volunteers planted native trees along the river. The native trees will help reduce erosion along the riverbank. The city will water the trees through their first summer.
reference: Volunteers planted native trees to reduce erosion along the river.

text: The town will replace its oldest water pipes this spring. The project will replace water pipes on three streets. Work crews will notify residents before interrupting water service. The town expects the project to finish in June.
reference: The town plans to replace its oldest water pipes this spring, with work expected to finish in June.
